simple.summary: מַעֲמָד (maʻămâd) means (figuratively) a position First listed occurrence: 1Chr 23 28.

definitions.full: H4612. maamad [ מַעֲמָד ] noun [masculine] office, function, service ; — 1 station, office, post ( מַעֲמָֽדְךָ ) Isa 22:19 (|| מַצָּֽבְךָ ), עַלמַֿעֲמָדָם 2Chr 35:15 at their post . 2 office, function 1Chr 23:28 . 3 service , probably specifically waiting at table (strictly mode of standing ), construct מְשָֽׁרְתָיו מַעֲמַד 1Kin 10:5 2Chr 9:4 .
